title: S24 later notes
findings_note: S24 review and UI pass later items, 2026-10-31

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later items from the S24 review and UI pass (2026-10-31). None blocked the gate.

- **Engine start reads the contract once.** `internal/engine/engine.go:250` (`Contract`) and `:258` (`RelayContract`) run the same `slicer ai relay --json --root P` twice, and the "contract changed during setup" check at `:262` compares two reads of one command. One `RelayContract` call with `CheckContractLine("Contract: "+contract.Contract)` does the job.
- **Doctor `found` has two formats.** The global `contract.found` is `"Contract: relay v11"` (`internal/cli/doctor.go:275`, read by `contractDirection` in `internal/cli/upgrade.go:160`); each project's `found` is the bare `"relay v11"` (`doctor.go:300`). Pick one, or keep both and say so in `docs/design.md`.
- **The accepted set is hard-coded and worded three ways.** The usage text (`internal/cli/cli.go:85`) says "(v10 or v11)" while the code builds the set from `roles.AcceptedContracts()`; other text says "10 or 11" (`docs/guide.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) and "relay v10, v11" (`internal/cli/pin.go`, `doctor.go`). Build the usage line from the set and use one phrase.
- **Unknown NAME in `projects pin` and `unpin`.** It exits 2 with `usage` and "Run 'ork help' for usage." Neighbouring commands give `not_found`, exit 1 (`internal/cli/wave.go:85`, `internal/daemon/handlers.go:239`). Decide the code, and point the hint at `ork projects list`.
- **No test for doctor skipping a registered project whose path is missing or not a directory** (`internal/cli/doctor.go:404-406`). The project finding covers it (`doctor.go:172-177`); add the test.
